verdict.rationale: Online filing is a fair question for a Secretary of State business-filing service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes that met bot walls (Akamai 403, Incapsula interstitials). No published page from the service was read that documents completing formation, registration, or annual-list filing online. Probe-3's passing reference to an ORION portal that 'state notices direct' filings to is the probe's own characterization, not a quoted first-party statement that the transaction can be completed online, so it cannot establish the capability.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
